My value is $48. I want to win if the second-highest bid is below my value and lose if it is above. Therefore, I should bid my value in the sealed bid auction. This way, in the ascending clock auction, I will drop out when the price reaches my value. If the other two bidders both bid higher than my value, I will drop out and not win, which is the correct outcome. If at least one bidder bids lower than my value, I will win the auction at the price of the second-highest bid.
